title: Norsine at Allagash in August 1976 running a tag-trace-retrieve exercise

tellings.quote: He said he was doing a TTR um tag trace retrieve exercise with a subcutaneous device

plain: A man named John Norsine claims he was at the Allagash Waterway in Maine in August 1976 running what he called a "TTR," a "tag trace retrieve exercise with a subcutaneous device": a tracking chip placed under the skin. Charlie Foltz, a witness to the strange events at the Allagash that summer, repeats what Norsine told him. If true, part of what happened there would have been a human operation.
